Local proofreading model

Gemma 4 E2B-it runs entirely inside Tapziq through LiteRT-LM. The verified model is downloaded only when you ask, kept in app-private storage, and works offline after installation. The download is 2.59 GB and requires roughly 3 GB of free space.

Download the local AI model?
Tapziq will download the pinned 2.59 GB Gemma 4 E2B-it model from Hugging Face, verify its SHA-256 checksum, and keep it in app-private storage. Wi-Fi is recommended.
Remove Gemma 4 E2B-it?
Tapziq will delete the verified model or any partial download, including any legacy runtime cache. Proofreading will stop working until you download and verify the model again.
Gemma 4 is still closing. Try removing it again in a moment.

Private by design

Typed text stays on your device. When you request proofreading, Tapziq briefly hashes up to 2,000 characters of the active field to verify it is unchanged; only the requested passage (up to 500 characters) is processed by the app-private Gemma 4 model. Tapziq does not save that text, read the clipboard, show ads, run analytics, or send proofreading text over the network. Network access is used only for the explicit model download.
Android shows a standard warning when any downloaded keyboard is enabled. Tapziq cannot enable or select itself; those choices stay under your control.
